abstract: INTRODUCTION: Primary extragonadal germ cell tumors (EGCT) are rare and it is still a matter of debate if they have to be considered as primary extragonadal issues or metastases from a primary testicular neoplasm. We describe two cases of the so-called burned-out seminoma, a primary testicular germ-cell tumor that spontaneously regressed after demonstration of retroperitoneal metastases. CASES PRESENTATION: Two patients (35 and 50 years old, respectively) presented with CT findings of retroperitoneal masses. In both cases physical examination of the testis was not suspicious, and only scrotal ultrasound (SUS) showed parenchymal alterations such as scarring, calcifications and nodular lesions. Left orchiectomy and chemotherapy were then performed in both cases. Currently, they are both free of disease. CONCLUSIONS: Although primary germ cell tumors may be of retroperitoneal origin, the likelihood of metastasis from a testicular primary origin should always be carefully considered in order to avoid misdiagnosis and to apply the best treatment schedule for the patients. Therefore, a testicular ultrasonography is mandatory in patients presenting CT findings of retroperitoneal adenopathy, even if patients are completely asymptomatic and their physical examination appears normal.
abstract_ja: はじめに: 原発性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍(EGCT)は稀であり、原発性性腺外病変とみなすべきか、それとも精巣原発腫瘍からの転移と考えるべきかについては議論が続いている。我々は、後腹膜転移が確認された後に自然退縮した、いわゆるburned-out seminomaの2例を報告する。症例提示: 2例(それぞれ35歳と50歳)は後腹膜腫瘤のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)所見で受診した。両例とも精巣の身体所見に異常はなく、陰嚢超音波検査(SUS)でのみ、瘢痕、石灰化、結節性病変などの実質変化が認められた。両例とも左精巣摘除術と化学療法を施行された。現在、両者とも病変はない。結論: 原発性胚細胞腫瘍は後腹膜起源のこともあるが、誤診を避け、最適な治療計画を立てるためには、精巣原発からの転移の可能性を慎重に考慮する必要がある。したがって、後腹膜リンパ節腫大のCT所見を有する患者では、無症状で身体診察が正常に見えても、精巣超音波検査が必須である。
